Senses.Explanation: Atop the lapis-lazuli hall — the shining height where walking shatters, where moss grows cold, and where, in the seamless-tower verse, there is no knowing. Yunju Daoying answers the brocade-clothed monk: wait till he walks atop the lapis-lazuli hall — even thrown down, he must shatter; Hongzhi Zhengjue tells the assembly the old saying — atop the lapis-lazuli hall the jade maiden throws her shuttle, before the bright-moon hall the stone man claps his hands — how do you walk so as to accord?; Hansong Zhicao, on the anniversary of the way's completion, opens the scene: atop the lapis-lazuli hall the precious mirror holds the radiance of the eight quarters, before the agate stairs the beaded curtain rolls up a sky of stars — say they all woke at once, and you fall into old Shakya's noose; Guxue Zhenzhe answers the upward-lift question with the pearl turning in the agate dish, and to the follow-up — mountains, rivers, and the great earth all baring the king's body — atop the lapis-lazuli hall the moon lingers; and Ruibai Mingxue, at the ten-year memorial for the layman's father, holds the fly-whisk, falls silent, then gives one couplet: atop the lapis-lazuli hall the green moss is cold, before the kingfisher curtain the jade pillow is chill. Danyuan Yingzhen, asked by the emperor for the meaning of the national teacher's seamless tower, answers in verse: south of the river, north of the pool, gold between them fills a nation; under the shadowless tree we share one boat — atop the lapis-lazuli hall, no knowing — and Xuedou Chongxian pinch-hits the emperor's not-understanding: does Danyuan understand? Just that one 'please show the tower's design' — all the patriarchs of India and China, squeezed thus, take south for north; Sanyi Mingyu, appraising the raised assembly words — kick over the seas, the great earth flies with dust; the great functioning present, how install it? — answers in four graphs: atop the lapis-lazuli hall, no knowing; and Chulin Shangrui, presenting the tower-gold for his late teacher, asks who would copy Emperor Daizong begging a design, the national teacher pointing at random, burdening later descendants who cannot paint Xiang-nan and Tan-bei — leaving, indeed, no knowing atop the lapis-lazuli hall — do you want to see the seamless tower? A long silence: buddhas and patriarchs cannot hide within it; gods and humans revere it for ten thousand ages.
